00002| // (rust/src/agentic_coding/evidence_record.rs).
00003| //
00004| // `planEvidenceRecordStep` is async: it re-plans the residual request through
00005| // the lead planner (`planChatStep`, `planSettledRoutes`) and may consult the
00006| // host solver. Importing ./planner.mjs here is a module cycle; it is safe
00007| // because nothing is called at module evaluation time.

00040| const DELIVERY_PROBE_TURNS = 4;
00041| const DELIVERY_PROBE_MEMO_CAPACITY = 512;

00045| /** Mirrors `fn parse_obligation`: a `DeliveryBinding` or null. */
00046| /**
00047|  * Mirrors `fn masked_multi_word_quotes`: `text` with every quoted segment that
00048|  * holds whitespace replaced, delimiters included, by as many `x` as it is long,
00049|  * so spans still index the original. A single-token quote — a backticked path
00050|  * or name — stays readable. The lines under a colon-ended first line are the
00051|  * request's payload, whatever they say, so they are masked the same way, line
00052|  * breaks kept (PR #1188 G95: a row that read "append ... to gaps.md" was taken
00053|  * for a delivery, and the answer was written over that file).
00054|  */
00055| function maskedMultiWordQuotes(text) {
00056|   let masked = text;
00057|   for (const segment of quotedSegmentSpans(text)) {
00058|     if (!/\s/u.test(segment.text)) continue;
00059|     masked = masked.slice(0, segment.start) + 'x'.repeat(segment.end - segment.start) + masked.slice(segment.end);
00060|   }
00061|   const end = instructionEnd(text);
00062|   return masked.slice(0, end) + masked.slice(end).replace(/\S/g, 'x');
00063| }

00065| function parseObligation(request) {
00066|   let target = null;
00067|   let firstLine = null;
00068|   let fieldLines = [];
00069|   let residual = '';
00070|   let laterObligation = false;
00071|   // Sentences and delivery cues are read with every multi-word quoted
00072|   // payload masked: `Append "/// Append an empty line to notes.txt." to
00073|   // src/lib.rs.` is one sentence about src/lib.rs, not a delivery to the
00074|   // notes.txt its payload mentions (PR #1188 sub-agent gap 2). The pinned
00075|   // line, field lines and the work before the delivery are read from the
00076|   // request itself, where the quoted text is intact.
00077|   const masked = maskedMultiWordQuotes(request);
00078|   for (const sentence of sentences(masked)) {
00079|     const spanText = request.slice(sentence.span.start, sentence.span.end);
00080|     const at = masked.indexOf(sentence.text, sentence.span.start);
00081|     const text = at < 0 ? sentence.text : request.slice(at, at + sentence.text.length);
00082|     const line = pinnedFirstLine(text);
00083|     if (line !== null && line !== undefined) {
00084|       if (target !== null && !laterObligation) {
00085|         if (firstLine === null) firstLine = line;
00086|         continue;
00087|       }
00088|       residual += spanText;
00089|       continue;
00090|     }
00091|     const delivered = carriesAuthoringTask(normalizePrompt(sentence.text)) ? null : deliveredWriteTarget(sentence.text);
00092|     if (delivered !== null && delivered !== undefined) {
00093|       if (target === null) {
00094|         fieldLines = exactFieldLines(text, delivered);
00095|         target = delivered;
00096|         const work = workBeforeDelivery(text);
00097|         if (work !== null) residual += `${work}. `;
00098|         continue;
00099|       }
00100|       laterObligation = true;
00101|     }
00102|     residual += spanText;
00103|   }
00104|   const trimmed = trim(residual);
00105|   if (trimmed === '' || target === null) return null;
00106|   return { target, first_line: firstLine, field_lines: fieldLines, residual: trimmed };
00107| }
00108| 
00109| function exactFieldLines(sentence, target) {
00110|   const fields = sentence.split('`')
00111|     .filter((_, index) => index % 2 === 1)
00112|     .map(trim)
00113|     .filter((quoted) => quoted !== target && !Array.from(quoted).some(isWhitespace))
00114|     .filter((quoted) => {
00115|       const equals = quoted.indexOf('=');
00116|       return equals >= 0 && /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(quoted.slice(0, equals));
00117|     });
00118|   return fields.filter((field, index) => !fields.slice(index + 1).includes(field));
00119| }
00120| 
00121| function workBeforeDelivery(sentence) {
00122|   const start = firstActionCueStart(tokens(sentence));
00123|   if (start === null || start === undefined) return null;
00124|   const work = withoutTrailingSeparator(trim(sentence.slice(0, start)));
00125|   return Array.from(work).some(isAlphanumeric) ? work : null;
00126| }
00127| 
00128| function withoutTrailingSeparator(work) {
00129|   const lowered = work.toLowerCase();
00130|   let best = null;
00131|   for (const separator of bareSurfaces('skill_procedure_clause_separator')) {
00132|     if (!lowered.endsWith(separator)) continue;
00133|     const kept = work.slice(0, work.length - separator.length);
00134|     const last = Array.from(kept).pop();
00135|     if (last === undefined || !isWhitespace(last)) continue;
00136|     const trimmedKept = trimEnd(kept);
00137|     if (best === null || trimmedKept.length < best.length) best = trimmedKept;
00138|   }
00139|   return best ?? work;
00140| }

00142| /**
00143|  * Mirrors `fn plan_evidence_record_step`.
00144|  * @param {string} task
00145|  * @param {Array<object>} messages
00146|  * @param {Array<string>} toolNames
00147|  */
00148| export async function planEvidenceRecordStep(task, messages, toolNames) {
00149|   const obligation = parseObligation(task);
00150|   if (!obligation) return null;
00151|   const reason = await laterRouteDelivering(task, obligation, toolNames);
00152|   if (reason !== null) {
00153|     traceRoute('evidence_record', reason);
00154|     return null;
00155|   }
00156|   const writeTool = toolFor(toolNames, Capability.Write);
00157|   if (!writeTool) return null;
00158|   const progress = Progress.scan(messages);
00159|   const outcome = observedFileOutcome(task, obligation.target, messages);
00160|   if (outcome.kind === 'satisfied') {
00161|     traceRoute('evidence_record', 'already_written');
00162|     const content = progress.successfulWriteContentFor(obligation.target);
00163|     const written = content === null || content === undefined ? '' : writtenObservation(obligation, content);
00164|     return resolvedFinalAnswer(written !== '' ? written : agenticMessage('evidence_record_recorded', { target: obligation.target }),
00165|       FinalDisposition.Finding, 'evidence_record_observed');
00166|   }
00167|   if (outcome.kind === 'refuted' || outcome.kind === 'unsatisfiable') {
00168|     traceRoute('evidence_record', 'write_not_observed');
00169|     return resolvedFinalAnswer(agenticMessage('evidence_record_write_failed', { target: obligation.target }),
00170|       FinalDisposition.Failure, 'evidence_record_write_failed');
00171|   }
00172|   let observed = null;
00173|   if (parseObligation(obligation.residual) === null && workspaceInspectionSearchForTask(obligation.residual) !== null) {
00174|     const latest = progress.latestSuccessfulOutput(Capability.Grep);
00175|     if (latest !== null && latest !== undefined && substantiveResultLine(latest, obligation.residual) !== '') observed = latest;
00176|   }
00177|   const residualMessages = withResidualRequest(messages, obligation.residual);
00178|   if (residualMessages === null) return null;
00179|   const isWorkspaceObservation = observed !== null;
00180|   let answer = observed;
00181|   if (answer === null) {
00182|     const plan = await planChatStepResolved(residualMessages, toolNames);
00183|     if (plan && plan.kind === 'tool_calls') {
00184|       traceRoute('evidence_record', 'investigating');
00185|       return plan;
00186|     }
00187|     if (plan && plan.kind === 'final') {
00188|       if (!canDeliverFinal(plan)) {
00189|         traceRoute('evidence_record', 'residual_not_a_finding');
00190|         return plan;
00191|       }
00192|       if (progress.latestFailure() !== null) {
00193|         traceRoute('evidence_record', 'residual_step_failed');
00194|         return resolvedFinalAnswer(plan.answer, FinalDisposition.Failure, 'residual_step_failed');
00195|       }
00196|       answer = plan.answer;
00197|     } else {
00198|       traceRoute('evidence_record', 'symbolic_residual');
00199|       const symbolic = await symbolicAnswer(obligation.residual);
00200|       if (symbolic === null) return null;
00201|       if (!canDeliverFinal(symbolic)) return symbolic;
00202|       answer = symbolic.answer;
00203|     }
00204|   }
00205|   traceRoute('evidence_record', obligation.target);
00206|   const deliveredAnswer = isWorkspaceObservation ? substantiveResultLine(answer, obligation.residual) : answer;
00207|   return planOne(writeTool, writeArguments(obligation.target, renderObligation(obligation, deliveredAnswer)));
00208| }

00210| async function laterRouteDelivering(task, obligation, toolNames) {
00211|   if (obligation.first_line !== null || obligation.field_lines.length) return null;
00212|   const plan = composeGeneralChangePlan(task);
00213|   if (plan !== null && plan.target === obligation.target) return 'declined_composed_target';
00214|   return (await settledRouteDelivers(task, obligation.target, toolNames)) ? 'declined_settled_route' : null;
00215| }
00216| 
00217| async function settledRouteDelivers(task, target, toolNames) {
00218|   const key = JSON.stringify([task, target, toolNames.join('\u001f')]);
00219|   if (deliveryProbeAnswers.has(key)) return deliveryProbeAnswers.get(key);
00220|   const answer = await probeSettledRoutes(task, target, toolNames);
00221|   if (deliveryProbeAnswers.size >= DELIVERY_PROBE_MEMO_CAPACITY) deliveryProbeAnswers.clear();
00222|   deliveryProbeAnswers.set(key, answer);
00223|   return answer;
00224| }

00226| async function probeSettledRoutes(task, target, toolNames) {
00227|   const probe = [{ role: 'user', content: task }];
00228|   for (let turn = 0; turn < DELIVERY_PROBE_TURNS; turn += 1) {
00229|     const plan = await planSettledRoutes(task, probe, toolNames);
00230|     if (!plan || plan.kind !== 'tool_calls') return false;
00231|     for (const [index, call] of plan.calls.entries()) {
00232|       if (plannedDestination(call.arguments) === target) return true;
00233|       const id = `delivery-probe-${turn}-${index}`;
00234|       probe.push({
00235|         role: 'assistant',
00236|         content: '',
00237|         tool_calls: [{ id, type: 'function', function: { name: call.tool, arguments: call.arguments } }],
00238|       });
00239|       probe.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: id, name: call.tool, content: 'ok' });
00240|     }
00241|   }
00242|   return false;
00243| }

00245| function plannedDestination(args) {
00246|   return plannedWritePath(args) ?? plannedCommandOutputPath(args);
00247| }
00248| 
00249| function plannedCommandOutputPath(args) {
00250|   const command = commandArgument(args);
00251|   if (command === null || command === undefined) return null;
00252|   const parts = splitWhitespace(command);
00253|   const index = parts.indexOf(OUTPUT_OPTION);
00254|   return index < 0 || parts[index + 1] === undefined ? null : parts[index + 1];
00255| }
00256| 
00257| function plannedWritePath(args) {
00258|   let value;
00259|   try {
00260|     value = JSON.parse(args);
00261|   } catch {
00262|     return null;
00263|   }
00264|   if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
00265|   const key = ['path', 'filePath', 'file_path', 'absolute_path'].find((candidate) => typeof value[candidate] === 'string');
00266|   return key === undefined ? null : value[key];
00267| }

00269| function renderObligation(obligation, answer) {
00270|   if (obligation.field_lines.length) {
00271|     const result = substantiveResultLine(answer, obligation.residual);
00272|     const observedResults = exactFieldValues(answer, 'result');
00273|     let next = 0;
00274|     let rendered = '';
00275|     for (const field of obligation.field_lines) {
00276|       rendered += field;
00277|       if (field.endsWith('=')) {
00278|         if (field === 'result=') {
00279|           rendered += nonHollowResult(combinedObservation(observedResults, obligation.residual) ?? result, obligation.residual);
00280|         } else {
00281|           rendered += next < observedResults.length ? observedResults[next++] : result;
00282|         }
00283|       }
00284|       rendered += '\n';
00285|     }
00286|     return rendered;
00287|   }
00288|   const text = trimEnd(nonHollowResult(answer, obligation.residual));
00289|   return obligation.first_line === null ? `${text}\n` : `${obligation.first_line}\n\n${text}\n`;
00290| }
00291| 
00292| function exactFieldValues(answer, key) {
00293|   const prefix = `${key}=`;
00294|   return lines(answer).map(trim).filter((line) => line.startsWith(prefix)).map((line) => line.slice(prefix.length));
00295| }

00297| function combinedObservation(values, request) {
00298|   if (!values.length) return null;
00299|   if (values.length === 1) return values[0];
00300|   const joined = values.join('; ');
00301|   return renderResponse('evidence_exact_composition', detect(request), [['values', joined]]) ?? joined;
00302| }
00303| 
00304| function nonHollowResult(raw, task) {
00305|   const result = trimEnd(raw);
00306|   const language = detect(task);
00307|   let intent;
00308|   if (result.endsWith(':') || result.endsWith('：')) intent = 'coding_repository_source_observation';
00309|   else if (splitWhitespace(result).length >= 4) return result;
00310|   else intent = 'coding_repository_result_observation';
00311|   return renderResponse(intent, language, [['result', result]]) ?? result;
00312| }

00314| function writtenObservation(obligation, content) {
00315|   const all = lines(content);
00316|   if (obligation.first_line !== null && all.length && trim(all[0]) === obligation.first_line) all.shift();
00317|   return trim(all.join('\n'));
00318| }

00320| function compareTuples(left, right) {
00321|   for (let index = 0; index < left.length; index += 1) {
00322|     if (left[index] !== right[index]) return left[index] - right[index];
00323|   }
00324|   return 0;
00325| }

00327| function substantiveResultLine(answer, task) {
00328|   let currentSourceAuthority = 0;
00329|   const candidates = [];
00330|   const completedSuffix = agenticMessage('evidence_record_command_output_suffix');
00331|   for (const rawLine of lines(answer)) {
00332|     const line = trim(rawLine);
00333|     if (looksLikeResultPathHeading(line)) {
00334|       currentSourceAuthority = sourceAuthority(line);
00335|       continue;
00336|     }
00337|     if (line !== '' && line !== '```text' && line !== '```' && !line.endsWith(completedSuffix) && !isMatchCount(line)) {
00338|       candidates.push([line, Math.max(currentSourceAuthority, sourceAuthority(line))]);
00339|     }
00340|   }
00341|   const terms = workspaceInspectionTermsForTask(task);
00342|   const conditionRequested = mentionsRole('coding_condition_subject_kind', task);
00343|   const implementationRequested = mentionsRole('coding_source_implementation_subject_kind', task);
00344|   const relationship = serializedRelationshipTerm(task) ?? null;
00345|   traceRoute('evidence_record_relationship', relationship ?? 'none');
00346|   traceRoute('evidence_record_terms', terms.join(','));
00347|   if (!candidates.length) return '';
00348|   const score = ([line, authority]) => relevanceScore(line, terms, conditionRequested, implementationRequested, relationship, authority);
00349|   let [selected] = candidates[0];
00350|   let selectedScore = score(candidates[0]);
00351|   for (const candidate of candidates.slice(1)) {
00352|     const candidateScore = score(candidate);
00353|     if (compareTuples(candidateScore, selectedScore) > 0) {
00354|       [selected] = candidate;
00355|       selectedScore = candidateScore;
00356|     }
00357|   }
00358|   traceRoute('evidence_record_selected', selected);
00359|   return selected;
00360| }

00362| function relevanceScore(line, terms, conditionRequested, implementationRequested, relationship, authority) {
00363|   const words = line.split(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/u).filter((word) => word !== '').map((word) => word.toLowerCase());
00364|   const matches = (term) => words.includes(term) || term.split('_').every((part) => words.includes(part));
00365|   const overlap = terms.filter(matches).length;
00366|   const requestedProperty = terms.length && matches(terms[terms.length - 1]) ? 1 : 0;
00367|   const declarationShape = looksLikeDeclaration(line)
00368|     ? 1 + (looksLikeLocalBinding(line) ? 0 : 1) + (looksLikeExposedDeclaration(line) ? 1 : 0)
00369|     : 0;
00370|   const boundRequested = terms.some((term) => mentionsRole('coding_bound_cue', term));
00371|   const semanticOverlap = boundRequested && words.some((word) => mentionsRole('coding_bound_cue', word)) ? 1 : 0;
00372|   const codeShape = /[{}();=<>]/u.test(line) ? 1 : 0;
00373|   const directIdentity = relationship !== null && words.some((word, index) => word === relationship && words[index + 1] === 'id') ? 1 : 0;
00374|   return [
00375|     implementationRequested && !isQuotedOrCommentedSource(sourceText(line)) ? 1 : 0,
00376|     directIdentity,
00377|     requestedProperty,
00378|     conditionRequested && looksLikeCondition(line) ? 1 : 0,
00379|     authority,
00380|     conditionRequested && looksLikeInstanceCondition(line) ? 1 : 0,
00381|     declarationShape,
00382|     semanticOverlap,
00383|     overlap,
00384|     codeShape,
00385|   ];
00386| }

00388| function looksLikeCondition(line) {
00389|   const source = sourceText(line);
00390|   if (isQuotedOrCommentedSource(source)) return false;
00391|   return ['if ', 'while ', 'match ', 'when '].some((prefix) => source.startsWith(prefix))
00392|     || ['&&', '||', '==', '!=', '>=', '<='].some((operator) => source.includes(operator))
00393|     || source.startsWith('!');
00394| }
00395| 
00396| function looksLikeInstanceCondition(line) {
00397|   const source = sourceText(line);
00398|   return ['self.', 'this.', 'self->', 'this->', '$this->'].some((receiver) => source.includes(receiver));
00399| }
00400| 
00401| function looksLikeLocalBinding(line) {
00402|   const source = sourceText(line);
00403|   return ['let ', 'var ', 'auto ', 'local '].some((prefix) => source.startsWith(prefix));
00404| }
00405| 
00406| function looksLikeExposedDeclaration(line) {
00407|   const keyword = splitWhitespace(sourceText(line))[0];
00408|   return keyword !== undefined && (['pub', 'public', 'export', 'exported'].includes(keyword) || keyword.startsWith('pub('));
00409| }
00410| 
00411| function looksLikeDeclaration(line) {
00412|   const source = sourceText(line);
00413|   if (isQuotedOrCommentedSource(source)) return false;
00414|   const colon = source.indexOf(':');
00415|   if (colon < 0) return false;
00416|   const left = source.slice(0, colon);
00417|   const right = source.slice(colon + 1);
00418|   const name = splitWhitespace(left).pop();
00419|   return !right.startsWith(':') && !/[()=+]/u.test(left) && name !== undefined && /^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/.test(name);
00420| }
00421| 
00422| function sourceText(line) {
00423|   const split = line.indexOf(': ');
00424|   return trim(split < 0 ? line : line.slice(split + 2));
00425| }
00426| 
00427| function isQuotedOrCommentedSource(source) {
00428|   return source.startsWith('//') || source.startsWith('/*') || source.startsWith('*') || source.startsWith('#')
00429|     || source.startsWith('<!--') || ['"', "'", '`'].includes(Array.from(source)[0]);
00430| }
00431| 
00432| function isMatchCount(line) {
00433|   if (!line.startsWith('Found ') || !line.endsWith(' matches') || line.length < 'Found  matches'.length) return false;
00434|   return Array.from(line.slice('Found '.length, line.length - ' matches'.length)).every(isAsciiDigit);
00435| }
00436| 
00437| function looksLikeResultPathHeading(line) {
00438|   return line.endsWith(':') && (line.startsWith('/') || line.startsWith('./'));
00439| }

00441| function sourceAuthority(pathOrLine) {
00442|   return trimEndMatches(pathOrLine, (character) => character === ':').split(/[/\\]/u).includes('src') ? 1 : 0;

00445| /**
00446|  * Mirrors `fn symbolic_answer` through the host solver (async).
00447|  * @param {string} residual
00448|  */
00449| /**
00450|  * The suffix of an intent that reports a gap -- `capability_gap`,
00451|  * `write_program_skill_gap`: a refusal, never content to record (PR #1188
00452|  * G102: a request describing a test file wrote the refusal into it).
00453|  */
00454| const GAP_INTENT_SUFFIX = '_gap';

00456| async function symbolicAnswer(residual) {
00457|   const answer = await solve(residual);
00458|   if (!answer) return null;
00459|   const text = trim(answer.answer ?? '');
00460|   if (text === '') return null;
00461|   const disposition = answer.intent.endsWith(GAP_INTENT_SUFFIX) ? FinalDisposition.Gap
00462|     : isInconclusive(answer) || defersToTheOpenWeb(answer) || announcesAListItDoesNotMake(answer)
00463|       ? FinalDisposition.Unknown : FinalDisposition.Finding;
00464|   return resolvedFinalAnswer(text, disposition, answer.intent);
00465| }

00467| function withResidualRequest(messages, residual) {
00468|   let index = -1;
00469|   for (let at = messages.length - 1; at >= 0; at -= 1) {
00470|     if (messages[at].role === 'user' && !isContinuationCue(plainText(messages[at].content))) {
00471|       index = at;
00472|       break;
00473|     }
00474|   }
00475|   if (index < 0) return null;
00476|   const out = messages.slice(0, index + 1).map((message) => ({ ...message }));
00477|   out[index].content = residual;
00478|   for (const message of messages.slice(index + 1)) {
00479|     if (message.role.toLowerCase() !== 'user') out.push({ ...message });
00480|   }
00481|   return out;
